research_question: Can a compact packet-causal CNN-GRU recover strong cross-domain P-candidate recall while retaining low continuous-background false-candidate rates and sub-second packet availability?

model_contract.initialization: random weights; no legacy or V25 checkpoint
model_contract.within_packet_context: all 50 samples of the fully received current packet
model_contract.cross_packet_context: previous packet embedding and two-layer unidirectional GRU state
model_contract.event_gradient_boundary: event-evidence loss trains its own head but is detached from the shared candidate backbone
model_contract.dense_phase_boundary: the target P packet receives a Gaussian sample target and every valid non-P sample receives a negative target; phase peak and soft mass enter the candidate head

event_sources: InstanceGM provider training and development accelerometer rows
K-NET event-disjoint and station-factorized training and development rows
development_data.label: post-P-only candidate and event-response labels; no P-pre positive packet

development_layers.dev_a: current event-disjoint InstanceGM development rows and event-plus-station-factorized K-NET development rows; used for architecture and epoch selection with provisional thresholds
development_layers.dev_b: opened GeoNet 2022 development material; used only after checkpoint freeze for final operating-point calibration
development_layers.final_threshold_boundary: the provisional threshold stored in each training checkpoint is not the final deployment threshold

optimization.checkpoint_selection: DEV-A gate count plus continuous gate progress; no retrospective fixed-test or DEV-B metric

development_acceptance.decision: do not add teacher distillation until the supervised V27 baseline is complete and diagnosed

opened_evidence_boundary.knet_fixed_701: opened retrospective benchmark; prohibited for V27 architecture, loss, threshold, or checkpoint selection
opened_evidence_boundary.instancegm_fixed_1170: opened retrospective benchmark; prohibited for V27 architecture, loss, threshold, or checkpoint selection
opened_evidence_boundary.legacy_cnn_gru_raw_replay: architecture motivation only; its weights and reported score are not admissible V27 evidence

future_final_test.source: new GeoNet strong-motion records not used for V27 development
future_final_test.freeze_rule: event, station, date range, preprocessing, thresholds, and model checksum must be frozen before first scoring
future_final_test.status: not yet constructed; current GeoNet download remains untouched

distillation_contingency.allowed_only_after: supervised V27 development baseline and error analysis are frozen
distillation_contingency.causal_target_rule: teacher input window must end at the current packet; only newest-packet teacher outputs may supervise the student
distillation_contingency.claim_boundary: teacher metrics and future-window availability cannot be inherited by the causal student

resource_policy.reason: avoid the prior multiprocess MPS swap and watchdog failure
